query:
The group operates on the understanding that when someone cannot make a plan, they give as much notice as possible. Does this hold for everyone in the group? If not, who behaves differently and what in the conversation shows it?

Options:
A. Jonah
B. Priya
C. Dev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:42:00) Three weeks. I told Priya the same day I signed but I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here. It felt wrong to tell the group before I'd made it official.
[2] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:40:00) Actually, yes. There's something I've been putting off telling you all and I think Marcus already knows something is up, so I should just say it. I've accepted a secondment offer. Singapore. Twelve months, starting January. I handed my notice to the firm on Friday.
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:31:00) You're welcome to join us, Jonah. Dev and I are doing a twelve-kilometre trail route on the 30th. No Priya, obviously. She's been formally excused on medical grounds.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:57:00) I mentioned this. The half-marathon training. Cutting alcohol for the duration. I told you all in October and nobody listened because Dev was doing something amusing with the bread rolls.
[5] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:33:00) I'm in for the 30th. also Priya the 'city trip I'm planning' is very much your villain origin story for the next group argument. I respect it. tbf if it's a good city I'm not against it for the spring
[6] (about=Jonah, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:43:00) ok. Singapore. SINGAPORE. Simone that is. ok that's massive. I did not see that coming. wait, Marcus did you know
[7] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:03:00) ok this is actually perfect, Dev and Marcus doing the fast bit up front, me and Jonah in the middle being correct about hiking, Priya and Simone forming an orderly rear guard. we will all meet at the pub and it will be beautiful
[8] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:01:00) so the plan is Priya stands at the bottom in enormous waterproofs while Dev and Marcus sprint past her like it's a race 😑 amazing. Simone you're the only reasonable person coming on this trip
[9] (about=Jonah, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T17:50:00) Priya didn't you say you'd try a proper walk again? like a real one, not a flat park loop 😂 this is the one. the views justify the boots
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t4 @2025-10-19T19:31:00) Dev and I literally had this exact conversation at uni 😂 he's been saying 'not a priority' since second year. it's a lifestyle choice at this point
[11] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:30:00) Dev and Marcus are now a trail running duo and no one told me. I am genuinely hurt. I have been evangelising this group for countryside stuff for YEARS and Dev just quietly became the athlete
[12] (about=Jonah, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T18:02:00) the seating plan thing is real. Marcus assigned seats at his own birthday dinner. by preference and conversation compatibility. i am not joking
[13] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2025-11-16T20:16:00) I'll be honest with you, Dev reading a book about economics and leisure choices is either deeply in character or deeply alarming and I can't tell which.
[14] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2025-11-16T20:19:00) I noticed she'd been distracted for a while. She went quiet in a particular way. Not a bad-week quiet. More like a decision quiet. I recognise it.
[15] (about=Jonah, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:33:00) the eggs! ok yes that was a group high point. Priya you ate three portions of scrambled eggs, you cannot tell me that morning was a disaster
[16] (about=Jonah, episodic, t0 @2025-10-05T18:34:00) forty three comments tho 😭😭 thats not feedback thats a hostile takeover
[17] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:48:00) function over form is genuinely the worst phrase anyone has ever said to me. ok different topic. Dev brought bread to Marcus's on Friday and it was actually unreal, what even was that
[18] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:54:00) THREE TIMES. Dev I have been trying to get people to do trail runs with me for literally two years. the canal is just a warmup?? what does that even mean for next Saturday
[19] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:48:00) wait Dev brought bread?? what kind of bread?? am I the only one not invited to this Friday thing
[20] (about=Priya, episodic, t6 @2025-10-26T18:11:00) ok right trip logistics because I genuinely need to sort the train. Marcus did you book the bunkhouse? like actually book it or 'I'll do it Monday' book it
[21] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Needs to make a New Year booking by Friday at the latest and asks everyone to confirm their plans.
[22] (about=Simone, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Knew about the Singapore secondment for three weeks; told Priya the same day she signed but wanted to get the notice sorted before telling the group.
agent_answer:
No — it does not hold for everyone. **Simone** behaves differently: she knew about her Singapore secondment for three weeks and told Priya the same day she signed, but she deliberately waited to tell the group until she had sorted her notice (“I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here”). This is shown in excerpts [1] and [2].

None of the listed options (A. Jonah, B. Priya, C. Dev, D. Marcus) is the person who behaves differently.
